description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' wraps Android's native Log utility to implement a linked logging node that forwards log messages, allowing for flexible logging chains. It implements the LogNode interface and manages the flow of log messages through a chain of LogNode objects.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility to enable chainable logging nodes and facilitate multiple log outputs.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable, then forwards the log to the next node if available.
